answer: Let influence accrue with tenure, not headcount. A new agent parks a deposit in a time-locked vault and sits on the ledge of probation, its voting weight throttled until it survives successive epochs and collects honest attestations. A gale of freshly minted sybils all begin at zero, stakes frozen, voices muted, while age cannot be bought in bulk. Flooding the network with names then buys only a pile of idle, slowly maturing accounts.
